FULL_MANIFESTATION.title: Full Manifestation
FULL_MANIFESTATION.description:
[gold]Rika[/gold] enters [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold] for 5 turns.
If she has stored [gold]Techniques[/gold], choose 1 to add to your [gold]hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
CURSED_ENERGY_REINFORCEMENT.title: Cursed Energy Reinforcement
CURSED_ENERGY_REINFORCEMENT.description:
Gain X [gold]Strength[/gold]. Gain X [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
Gain X Energy.|}
KNOCK_IT_DOWN.title: Knock It Down!
REVERSE_CURSED_TECHNIQUE.title: Reverse Cursed Technique
IMITATION.title: Imitation
IMITATION.description:
[gold]Rika[/gold] deals {RikaDamage:diff()} damage.
If [gold]Fatal[/gold], Rika devours a [gold]Technique[/gold]: choose 1 of 3 cards from other characters to store in the [gold]Promise Ring[/gold]. Rare cards in Elite and Boss fights.
BIND.title: Bind
BIND.description: Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP. [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold] lasts {FullManifestationPower:diff()} more turns.
WHICH_ONE_YUTA.title: Yuta, Which One?
WHICH_ONE_YUTA.description:
During [gold]Full Manifestation[/gold], at the start of each turn choose 1 of 3 {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]upgraded[/gold] |}cards to add to your [gold]hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
Rika's stored [gold]Techniques[/gold] are offered first; cards from other characters fill the rest.
